name: Witnessing To Others
overview: Scripture calls believers to boldly proclaim God's righteousness and faithfully speak His commands, regardless of personal limitations, as seen in Psalms 40:9 and Jeremiah 1:7. Jesus commissions His followers to actively engage in making disciples, promising transformative purpose by calling them to be 'fishers of men' (Matthew 4:19) and to teach all nations, baptizing them in the triune name (Matthew 28:18-19). Additionally, believers are urged to let their godly conduct shine before others, so that their good works glorify the Father in heaven (Matthew 5:16), demonstrating that witnessing encompasses both verbal proclamation and living testimony.
